scope: Read-only G09 source review of immutable commit, not a build or native test
checks: GOP LocateProtocol/QueryMode/SetMode/FreePool run only before final map freeze; EBS retry path retains only GetMemoryMap and ExitBootServices.
BootInfo default 1.1 remains exact; opt-in 1.2 validates flags, extension pointer at retained page+128, 64-byte extension layout and all original retained allocations.
GOP bytes may end before a page boundary; validated visible stride*height*4 fits byte_len, mapping rounds visible length, RAM overlap check uses entire rounded span.

Framebuffer can overlap only MMIO type11 or unreported holes; all ordinary, runtime, reserved, ACPI and unknown descriptor types are denied. Base is outside low RAM and each mapped physical page is checked against MAXPHYADDR.

Separate framebuffer VA window and immutable base/length allow actual page walk audit of physical binding and supervisor RW/NX/UC bits. Existing virtio MMIO wrapper retains original VA/alignment constraints.
A full clipped private RAM row is rendered before aligned volatile stores; only width pixels per scanline are written, excluding stride padding and mapped last-page padding.

PS/2 setup commands and response/drain waits are bounded. AUX/parity/timeout input resets decoder state. Set1 make/break, modifiers, bounded ASCII and backspace are handled by dependency-free safe no_std code.
Graphics bootstrap has interrupts disabled and cannot be combined with milestone-m3; no claim of ring-3 apps, persisted files, compositor, native M7 or full desktop.

QMP uses a private per-child Unix socket with no guest networking, only synthetic writable VARS and readonly boot ESP; screendumps come from QEMU and backspace must restore the previous frame exactly.

nonblocking_followups.detail: Parse G0:FRAMEBUFFER width/height/stride/pixel format and bind dimensions to actual PPM size; check post-EBS/KS markers in order rather than counts alone before final capture. Root has been notified.

limitations: Code review by another AI is not a human audit or formal proof.
Framebuffer/keyboard behavior still requires a successful real G0 QEMU run; host core tests alone are not that evidence.
Review pinned to 7c05218; later merge conflict resolutions require comparison before applying this review to the merged source.
